title: calamus oblongus subsp. depressiusculus
intro: Calamus oblongus subsp. depressiusculus, commonly known as Lesser Calamus, is a plant species that belongs to the family Zingiberaceae and is native to Southeast Asia. It is valued for its health benefits, including its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial agent, which can help to alleviate symptoms of digestive issues, respiratory problems, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Lesser Calamus include its sedative, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, making it useful in treating anxiety, insomnia, and coughs. The bioactive constituents of Lesser Calamus include essential oils, phenolic compounds, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
